acceptanceCriteria: A check (CI or merge-queue) refuses a PR whose analyzer schema number equals main's while the pinned hash differs
Docs name the recovery (rebump to next number)
body: Observed 2026-10-18: PR #1088 (V1-1674) and PR #1096 (V1-1698) both bump the analyzer schema to corvint-analyzer/122 with different pinned hashes. Whichever merges second fails its schema pin test in the merge queue or silently reuses a number for different analyzer content. No check reserves or detects colliding schema numbers across open branches.
title: Concurrent PRs bumping corvint-analyzer schema to the same number are not detected before merge
